name: aiseo-monthly-technical-audit
prompt: Run technical-seo-audit on the primary site stored in MEMORY.md (site_root = primary site origin). Use focus=all and sample_pages=3. Produce the 3-section technical audit report. If MEMORY.md has no primary site, ask the user and skip this run.
prompt_template: Run technical-seo-audit on {primary_site} (site_root = primary site origin). Use focus=all and sample_pages=3. Produce the 3-section technical audit report.

_aiseo_notes.purpose: monthly deep technical scan — robots / sitemap / hreflang chain / canonical chain / mobile / structured-data
_aiseo_notes.tool_budget: <= 6 web_extract calls (root + robots + sitemap + 3 sampled inner pages); 0 browser calls expected unless web_extract fails
_aiseo_notes.deliver_choice_rationale: same as weekly-audit — local sink, no messaging
